correctness.rationale: All-order upper and lower bounds were rederived from distinct graph-part colour requirements and Hall matching; the chromatic-palette matching case handles singleton parts and all answer patterns. The online dimension of any single-valued n-vertex equality-query concept class is at most n. For the finite octahedron, exact enumeration of 96 four-colour assignments and all reachable query splits rules out depth five; an independently checked complete 64-leaf proper five-colour certificate constructs depth six. The executable files, certificate and output are embedded and replayed from the new package.
